# ImageCompress Ultra
> Free browser-based image compressor — compress to exact file sizes (20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB), visa photo tools, batch processing. No upload required — all processing runs in your browser.

## What this site does
ImageCompress Ultra compresses images to specific target sizes entirely in the browser. No files are uploaded to any server. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP. Key use cases: visa photos, passport photos, email attachments, social media, government forms (DS-160, USCIS, N-400).

## Key USP
- Files never leave your browser — 100% private
- Compress to exact KB target (20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB, 500KB, 1MB)
- Visa photo tools for 70+ countries
- Batch compression and ZIP download
- No signup, no watermark, free

## Privacy
All image processing runs client-side in the browser using JavaScript Canvas API. No image data is uploaded, stored, or transmitted to any server. Files are processed locally and deleted from memory after download.

## Who this is for
Anyone needing to compress images to a specific file size: visa applicants, passport photo submissions, email senders, social media users, e-commerce sellers, students submitting exam applications, job seekers.

## What this site does NOT cover
Advanced photo editing, background removal, AI upscaling. For paycheck calculations see privatepaycheck.com.
